payload.title: Test ClayCode-native Retina/Qwen percept seeds -> UnifiedDB/EAP -> self.root with experience dose-response
payload.work_clay: Build a matched target-VPS differential connecting typed ClayCode visual evidence to the existing UnifiedDB Emergent Assembly Preprocessor. Frozen fixtures may isolate on-VPS mechanics. Live remote/local visual sources must follow secure transport -> token auth -> client/session/provenance -> Retina/Qwen/MVC physical perception -> ClayCode VisualPercept/PerceptualField. Derive PerceptualMemorySeed only from admissible ClayCode percept semantics and current provenance; never seed canonical memory directly from a German caption, raw OCR string or untyped Qwen prose. Resolve current UnifiedDB refs, compile bounded EAP ActiveAssemblies and compare QWEN_ONLY, DIRECT_MEMORY, PAR_RAW_QWEN_FEATURE_PROJECTED_TO_CLAY, PAR_CLAY_PERCEPT_SEED, and EAP-guided active-sensing variants. Independently manipulate self.root-specific target-relevant episodic experience at N={0,1,2,4,8,16,32,64} independent provenance-bound episodes, extend geometrically if useful, hold pretrained Qwen/model/runtime constant and report N_onset/N_robust/N_90/N_harm. One episode requires independent evidence/context/outcome; repeated frames do not inflate N. Run recurrence/state-variant/relational-transfer/novel/conflicting and irrelevant SHAM_N regimes. Also separate general perceptual-memory EAP from the native self.root SelfContextAssembly hot path: when the content is explicitly self-reference, compare NORMAL_RETRIEVAL vs PREBOUND_SELF_CONTEXT and ensure general EAP does not duplicate or corrupt the self hot path. Retrieved memory remains context-only and cannot override current sensor evidence, identity truth or effect authority.
payload.reason_clay: The latest directives make self.root the native identity and ClayCode the sole cognitive semantic language. Therefore PAR must operate on ClayCode-native percept seeds and must coexist with the dedicated self.root SelfContextAssembly. This creates a more precise architecture: general perception can purchase associative context through EAP, while self-reference can activate precompiled self context without an additional ordinary external retrieval roundtrip. The target VPS/API boundary makes client/session provenance and end-to-end cost mandatory. The experience-dose factorial remains necessary to distinguish actual self.root episodic learning from pretrained Qwen knowledge, cache effects or generic extra context.
payload.completion_clay: A reproducible target-VPS report gives secure transport/auth/session latency for live inputs, VisualPercept construction/validation cost, seed-resolution cost, EAP cost, SelfContextAssembly activation cost when applicable, and full sensor/client-to-correct-outcome p50/p95/p99. It reports ClayCode semantic fidelity, memory precision/recall, false familiarity, wrong-memory acceptance, sensor override failures, identity-contamination failures, false GWT ignition, stale epoch/provenance rejection and crash/restart/replay. It includes QWEN_ONLY, DIRECT_MEMORY_N, PAR_EAP_N, PAR_ACTIVE_N and SHAM_N dose curves and N_onset/N_robust/N_90/N_harm. It must prove that PAR beats or fails to beat simpler direct memory at equal N, that wrong-seed/shuffled/stale controls collapse any claimed benefit, and that explicit self-reference uses the self.root hot path without duplicated retrieval or identity drift. German surface translation is tested only at the boundary and must not be required for canonical perceptual memory semantics.
payload.executor_policy: Primary evidence runs on the current Hostinger target VPS. Core memory/perception semantics must be ClayCode-only. Frozen visual fixtures isolate mechanisms; live sources use the token-authenticated API. Never store raw production tokens. Do not count Qwen pretrained knowledge as self.root experience. Do not call EAP or self-context literally zero-latency; measure them. Keep general perceptual EAP distinct from self.root SelfContextAssembly and test their interaction explicitly. No paid training.
invalidators: A newer executed target-VPS receipt already measures the same ClayCode-percept EAP and self-context interaction differential
UnifiedDB/EAP or self-context semantics are superseded
